arg.name: image1
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: image2
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show edge image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specigy queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: alpha
arg.description: Weight of the first array elements

arg.name: approximate_sync
arg.description: Flag of approximate_sync. If this value is false, image1 and image2 synchronize exact time.
